guitar.evidence: Pat Travers is documented playing Gibson Les Pauls and Firebirds during his late-70s peak including 'Boom Boom (Out Go the Lights)' era.

tone.target: bright British crunch with wah bite
tone.profile: bright British crunch with wah bite
tone.summary: A classic Marshall/Plexi-style chain featuring a Boost for initial punch, followed by the Wah pedal, leading into a UK 45 amp model with a UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet to achieve the required aggressive British bite.
